sentences.text:
Author: Indrajit Chatterjee
Bench: Indrajit Chatterjee
08.2015 Cra 109 of 1998 Ct. 27 None is present on behalf of the Kolkata Municipal Corporation.

The record shows that this is an appeal against acquittal as against the judgment dated 31st May 1997 passed by the Senior Municipal Magistrate, Calcutta in Case No. 30-D of 1988 under section 16(1) a(i) read with section 7 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 in which the said learned trial court was pleased to acquit all the three accused persons being the proprietor, person- in-charge and seller.
The complainant was Dr. S.K. Basu, Food Inspector of the then Calcutta Municipal Corporation (as it was called then).

Let administrative notice be issued to the Chief legal Advisor, Kolkata Municipal Corporation at No.
5, S.N. Banerjee Road after taking instruction from the said corporation as to whether the said corporation is still willing to proceed with this appeal and if the officer is in the affirmative, then one advocate must be engaged to represent the appellant.
Department is directed to send a copy of this order by special messenger to that officer.
Let it come in the list on 15th September 2015.

(Indrajit Chatterjee, J.)
109/1998 on 17 August, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59946563/
